newsitem.title: USA: Aliant files for Nebraska rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Aliant files for Nebraska rate increase.

text.p: Aliant Communications Inc said on Thursday it has filed a notice with the Nebraska Public Service Commission to increase rates for pay telephones and local directory service, effective March 23.
The pay phone rate will rise to $0.35 a call from $0.25, and the directory assistance rate will move to $0.60 a call with one free call a month from $0.40 with two free calls a month.
"The increase will help Aliant Communications maintain and improve its strong communications network," Frank Hilsabeck, president and chief executive of Aliant, said in a statement.
Last November, Aliant said it notified its customers of long distance rate reductions and basic local service rate increases, also effective March 23.
Alliant is a diversified communications company.
